chapters.screen: Gradient Boosting. Boosting builds its answer as a sum of small trees. Each new tree looks at what the model still gets wrong and nudges the log-odds of survival to fix a little of it. Watch the maps sharpen one correction at a time.
chapters.spoken: Gradient Boosting. Boosting builds its answer as a sum of small trees. Each new tree looks at what the model still gets wrong and nudges the log-odds of survival to fix a little of it. Watch the maps sharpen one correction at a time.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: Start: F₀ is the log-odds of the training survival rate, the same for everyone, so nobody is predicted to survive yet.
chapters.spoken: Start: F zero is the log-odds of the training survival rate, the same for everyone, so nobody is predicted to survive yet.

chapters.screen: Each tree fits the current errors and is added at 0.1 strength in log-odds: F_m = F_m−1 + 0.1 × h_m, P = σ(F). Later frames skip ahead several trees.
chapters.spoken: Each tree fits the current errors and is added at 0.1 strength in log-odds: F m equals F m minus 1 plus 0.1 times h m, P equals sigma of F. Later frames skip ahead several trees.

chapters.screen: 80 trees: train accuracy 82%, validation 76%. Small steps keep any one tree from over-reacting.
chapters.spoken: 80 trees: train accuracy 82%, validation 76%. Small steps keep any one tree from over-reacting.

chapters.screen: For an unseen passenger boosting starts from the base-rate log-odds, every tree adds its correction, and the sigmoid turns the total into a probability.
chapters.spoken: For an unseen passenger boosting starts from the base-rate log-odds, every tree adds its correction, and the sigmoid turns the total into a probability.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: Boosting adds up many small trees' steps and turns the total into a probability, so each sheet is made of flat blocks. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: Boosting adds up many small trees' steps and turns the total into a probability, so each sheet is made of flat blocks. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 83% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 83% with every input against 80% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: Boosting turns many weak trees into a strong model by fitting each one to the errors that remain. Limitation: trees are added in sequence, and with too many trees or a high learning rate it starts fitting noise in a dataset this small.
chapters.spoken: Boosting turns many weak trees into a strong model by fitting each one to the errors that remain. Limitation: trees are added in sequence, and with too many trees or a high learning rate it starts fitting noise in a dataset this small.
